title.narrative: Improved capacity of constituents to promote fundamental principles and rights at work

description.narrative: The tripartite constituents have prioritized implementing fundamental principles and rights at work, particularly in supply chains and sectors most susceptible to practices of child and bonded labour and other precarious work, such as agriculture sector, informal economy including domestic work, home based work. Recognizing the importance of formalizing the informal economy, especially in rural areas, the social partners are advocating for the application of labour legislation to regulate working conditions and ensure access to decent work. By collaborating with stakeholders across the supply chain, including farmers, workers, and others engaged in the lower tier of the supply chain, the social partners are advocating to create of a more transparent and accountable system that upholds labour rights and ethical practices. Formalizing the informal economy, particularly in rural areas, is a multifaceted endeavour that involves the application of labour legislation and the implementation of supportive policies. By bringing informal workers into the formal sector, the tripartite stakeholders aim to begin the provision of legal protections, access to social security, and opportunities for skill development and upward mobility. This not only improves the livelihoods of rural communities but also contributes to overall economic development and poverty reduction. At the federal level,the government is committed to develop a FPRW strategy. The strategy will anchor the support to National Statistics Offices in mainstreaming FPRW indicators in national statistics. This is important to be able to report positively and progressively on ILS but also commitments like the GSP Plus. The support will also include the integration of efforts to curb trafficking in persons through the adoption of P20 action plans and alignment of legal frameworks. The support to the development of the child labour polciies at the provincial level will be integral to the achievement under this priority.
